series.name: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)
series.notes: Bare-integer scheme, NO F prefix, and it collides head-on with the SDT-G3/UT/ESS tables - see CONFLICTS. Documented models GW5000/GW6000/GW7600/GW9600-ES-US20 and the SBP-US string inverters. North American safety standard (UL/NETL) so the GFCI and AFCI rows and the no-auto-recover rows apply. The manual's own numbering jumps from 24 straight to 26 - there is no row 25. Not a Pakistan line; Pakistan uses ES Uniq / SDT G3 / ET, so scope this series to US-market units only.

title.ur: Utility Loss - grid power chala gaya (1)

meaning.en: Grid power has failed, or the AC cable is disconnected or the AC breaker is off.
meaning.ur: Grid power chali gayi, ya AC cable disconnect hai ya AC breaker off hai.

causes.ur: Grid power supply fail ho gayi.

causes.en: AC cable disconnected or the AC breaker is off.
causes.ur: AC cable disconnect hai ya AC breaker off hai.

solutions.en: The alarm clears automatically once grid power returns.
solutions.ur: Grid power aane par alarm khud ba khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker is ON and the AC cable terminations are tight.
solutions.ur: AC breaker ON hai aur AC cable ke connections tight hain ya nahi check karein.

notes.en: On SDT-G3 and EH the same condition is F01; on UT the bare integer 1 means SPI Comm Fail. Never merge.
notes.ur: SDT-G3 aur EH par yehi halaat F01 hai; UT par bare integer 1 ka matlab SPI Comm Fail hai. Kabhi merge na karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: Grid voltage is out of the permissible range or stayed high beyond the HVRT requirement, so the unit disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se bahar hai ya HVRT requirement se zyada der high raha, is liye unit disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage exceeds the permissible range.
causes.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se zyada hai.

causes.en: High-voltage duration exceeds the HVRT requirement.
causes.ur: High voltage ki duration HVRT requirement se zyada rahi.

solutions.en: Occasional trips clear themselves once the grid is normal.
solutions.ur: Kabhi kabhi aane wale trips grid normal hote hi khud clear ho jate hain.

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage against the permissible range; contact the power company if it is out of range.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se compare karein, range se bahar ho to power company ko contact karein.

solutions.en: Only with the power company's consent, change the overvoltage threshold or HVRT.
solutions.ur: Sirf power company ki ijazat se overvoltage threshold ya HVRT badlein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: Grid voltage is below the permissible range or stayed low beyond the LVRT requirement.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se neeche hai ya LVRT requirement se zyada der low raha.

causes.en: Grid voltage lower than the permissible range.
causes.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se kam hai.

causes.en: Low-voltage duration exceeds the LVRT requirement.
causes.ur: Low voltage ki duration LVRT requirement se zyada rahi.

solutions.en: Let it self-recover; a one-off is usually a temporary grid abnormality.
solutions.ur: Khud recover hone dein, aik baar ka issue aam tor par grid ki temporary abnormality hoti hai.

solutions.en: Measure voltage at the AC breaker as well as the inverter, and compare the two readings.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur inverter dono par voltage measure karke dono readings compare karein.

solutions.en: Check for a long or undersized AC run causing voltage drop under load.
solutions.ur: Lamba ya chhota AC cable load ke saath voltage drop kar raha hai ya nahi check karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: The 30mA residual current channel saw an abnormal value, usually insulation leakage from the PV side.
meaning.ur: 30mA residual current channel ne abnormal value dekha, aam tor par PV side se insulation leakage ki wajah se.

causes.en: PV string insulation impedance to ground falls while running.
causes.ur: Chalne ke daurat PV string ka ground se insulation impedance gir jata hai.

causes.en: Moisture in DC connectors or cable damage.
causes.ur: DC connectors mein paani ya cable damage.

solutions.en: Note whether it correlates with wet weather; wet-morning trips are common and often benign.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke kya ye geelay mausam se correlate karta hai, geelay mausam ki subah trip aam hai aur aksar halat hota hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and measure each string to PE; find and dry out the offending string.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur har string ko PE se measure karein, masoom string dhoond kar use sukha dein.

solutions.en: If it is frequent, contact the dealer rather than repeatedly resetting.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to baar baar reset karne ke bajaye dealer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Codes 12, 13, 14 and 15 on this unit are the 30mA, 60mA, 150mA and gradual-change GFCI stages. On the EMEA ESS app the same bare number 12 means Internal Fan Failure.
notes.ur: Is unit par 12, 13, 14 aur 15 GFCI ke 30mA, 60mA, 150mA aur gradual change stages hain. EMEA ESS app par 12 ka matlab Internal Fan Failure hai.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: PV string to PE resistance fell below the trip level; the manual's acceptance value is above 50kOhm.
meaning.ur: PV string se PE ka resistance trip level se neeche gir gaya, manual ke mutabiq 50kOhm se upar hona chahiye.

causes.ur: PV string PE se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Moist environment with poorly insulated cable to ground.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul aur ground ke mutabiq kamzor insulation wali cable.

solutions.en: Isolate DC and measure PV string to PE; it must read above 50kOhm.
solutions.ur: DC isolate karke PV string se PE measure karein, 50kOhm se upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If it fails, disconnect strings one at a time to find the shorted string.
solutions.ur: Test fail ho to strings ko aik aik disconnect karke shorted string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Check the PE cable of the inverter is connected properly.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka PE cable theek se laga hua hai ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is only low on rainy days, reset the ISO setting in the app.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf barsaat ke din reading kam ho to app se ISO setting reset karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: The relay self-test failed because of a relay fault, an abnormal control circuit, or abnormal AC cable connection.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test fail hua kyunke relay kharab hai, control circuit abnormal hai ya AC cable connection abnormal hai.

causes.ur: Relay abnormal hai ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: AC cable connection loose or short-circuited.
causes.ur: AC cable connection dhili hai ya short ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect AC output and DC input, wait 5 minutes, then reconnect before investigating further.
solutions.ur: AC output aur DC input disconnect karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara connect karein.

solutions.en: With AC isolated, re-torque the AC output terminals and look for heat discoloration.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke AC output terminals ki tightening karein aur garmi ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Test relay contact continuity and coil supply, then replace the relay if failed.
solutions.ur: Relay contact ki continuity aur coil supply test karein, phir relay kharab ho to replace karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

meaning.en: An arc was detected on the DC side, typically from a DC terminal that is not firmly connected or a broken DC cable.
meaning.ur: DC side par arc detect hua, aam tor par dhale DC terminal ya tooti DC cable ki wajah se.

causes.en: The DC terminal is not firmly connected.
causes.ur: DC terminal dheela band nahi hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and confirm the DC side is dead before any inspection.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur inspect karne se pehle confirm karein ke DC side dead hai.

solutions.en: Follow the Quick Installation Guide and re-check every DC connection for tightness and correct polarity.
solutions.ur: Quick Installation Guide follow karke har DC connection ki tightness aur polarity dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any connector showing heat damage, melting or a loose crimp.
solutions.ur: Garmi se kharab, pighle hua ya dhila crimp wala connector replace karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting
